Hi Rishi / Kimberly,

Following up on our audit intake: the auditor has asked for a consolidated view showing (1) our authenticated external scan cadence, (2) internal scheduled scans, and (3) how we map CVE remediation SLAs to severity tiers. Specifically they want: a) proof that scans ran over the last 90 days, b) a table showing SLA windows for Critical/High/Med, and c) an attestation that outstanding CVEs listed (CSV attached) have owners and target remediation dates.

I attached the CSV from our scanner with the current findings (scan-dashboard-20261124.csv). Could you confirm what we can provide by EOD Monday? Also — we need a short signed letter that we can hand to the auditor (SOC 2 style) stating our remediation cadence and escalation path.

Thanks,
